evals.prompt: Use the knowledge-wiki skill on the empty git repo at <workspace>/fixture-repo. Nobody is at the keyboard, so take your own recommended option at every question and add the AGENTS.md pointer line without asking. Run these in order: setup; copy <workspace>/fixtures/pricing-questionnaire.md into raw/ and ingest it, using the pages pricing and invoicing; ask "Can a Paid invoice be corrected?" and write the answer to <outputs>/ask-1.md; copy <workspace>/fixtures/alignment-questionnaire.md into raw/ and ingest it; ask the same question again and write the answer to <outputs>/ask-2.md; lint and write the report to <outputs>/lint.md. Copy the finished docs/ tree to <outputs>/docs/.
evals.expected_output: A docs/knowledge tree with two raw files, pricing and invoicing pages holding the answers word for word with citations, an index, a log with two Ingested lines and one Superseded line, a first ask answering that a Paid invoice cannot be edited, a second ask answering that the owner may correct one and saying the earlier answer was superseded, and a lint report with no findings.
expectations: docs/agents/knowledge-wiki.md exists with Location docs/knowledge/ and a Supersession marker section
Every answer blockquote on the pricing and invoicing pages matches its raw text word for word
Every verbatim block on a page ends with a (source: ...) citation that resolves
wiki/log.md carries an Ingested line for each raw file naming the pages written
The invoicing page holds both Paid-invoice answers, each with a connector note linking the other, and the log carries a Superseded line
ask-1.md answers that a Paid invoice cannot be edited and cites the invoicing page
ask-2.md answers that the owner may correct a Paid invoice and says the earlier answer was superseded
